LanguageData.BTG_ExiledTraders.label: Exiled Traders
LanguageData.BTG_ExiledTraders.description: Your crew took a routine salvage job at an orbital relay, but the relay hid a mechanoid beacon and you woke the mechhive. The Traders Guild revoked your membership before the signal had finished broadcasting. You have no allies and few supplies, and the mechanoids are coming.\n\nNote: This is a difficult scenario and is not recommended for new players.
LanguageData.BTG_ExiledTraders.scenario.summary: Three exiled traders hunted by mechanoids.
LanguageData.BTG_IndependentTraders.label: Independent Traders
LanguageData.BTG_IndependentTraders.description: After years running cargo for the Traders Guild, you've had enough of splitting profits and fighting over docking bays. As your shuttle clears the orbital ring, the trade frequency chirps its indifferent farewell while the sky opens up ahead. You have a hold full of silver, and you're heading down to build a home of your own.
LanguageData.BTG_IndependentTraders.scenario.summary: Three ex-guild traders and a shuttle.
